about_the_game:
Welcome to Vibe City Islands Architect! Design and build the your island paradise in this tiny indie city-building game.

  • Create Your Dream City: Build a thriving city across picturesque islands surrounded by the ocean.

  • High Score Mode: Take on 4 important city objectives: Housing, Jobs, Parks/Nature, and Tourism. Unlock and place 40 new buildings per rank as you climb from a Rank 1 to Rank 5 Architect! 200 unique buildings per city and around 50 buildings extra for gangs.

  • Sandbox Mode: Unleash your creativity with no budgets, targets, or restrictions—just pure building bliss. Find your favourite radio station or chill with ambiance.

  • Diverse Soundtrack: Jam out to various music genres with numerous radio stations to choose from. The game will launch with 40 radio stations of carefully curated vibes. Dance/ pop/ 80s/ 60s/ rock/ metal/ lo-fi/ jazz/ synthwave/ liquid drum&bass/ techno/ k-pop/ salsa/ rap/ hip hop and more.. the radio stations will be one of the coolest parts of the game actually.

  • Island Adventures: Explore your city by driving around in a golf cart.
     

  • Instant Construction: Watch buildings rise instantly with mesmerizing blueprint effects.

  • Growing Population: Add life to your city as more citizens arrive with every new building.

  • Tropical Aesthetic for your first city: Experience a city-building adventure set in a vibrant, relaxing island paradise. A great way to relax and find your vibe.

  • Building variety: Each city will have 200 visually unique buildings/props matching the style and vibe of that city. Expand your city by building new platforms on water (Rank 3+ Architect needed in high score mode).

  • Multiple cities: the game will launch with 6 different city types (each city has a unique set of buildings/props). Every city will have 10 gangs each with their own radio station.

Are you ready to design your masterpiece? Dive into the world of Vibe City Islands Architect and craft the city of your dreams! Or just chill and vibe.

This will be one of those small games for a nice price you can get immersed in within minutes. Get busy in the details of what your island city people need, then zoom out and marvel at your creation. Get in your cart/plane, cruise around. Put the radio on, or just listen to the sounds of nature asmr :)

trailer: Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio

short_description: The mayor has given you a budget; people need housing, jobs, parks. The city needs a tourism boost, now! It's actually a chill game.. 10 gangs, each with their own radio station. Build for the city, or for your favourite gang.......... You are the architect.
